run_download_imgur5k_dataset: run the imgur5k dataset download script with --dataset_info_dir and --output_dir arguments
run_compute_image_hash: run compute_image_hash to get the MD5 hash of a downloaded image file
run_create_split_json: run _create_split_json to filter annotations into train, val, or test split JSONs
refactor_compute_image_hash: refactor compute_image_hash to use SHA-256 instead of MD5 for stronger image verification
review_main_download_pipeline: review the main download pipeline that fetches images, verifies hashes, and generates annotation JSONs
